items.title: refactor: split two files off the max-lines cap (#131353)
items.summary: refactor: split two files off the max-lines cap (#131353) * refactor(cron): resolve model preflight behind one policy call prepareCronRunContext sat at the 700-line cap with a ~40-line inline loop that walked preflight candidates while tracking three mutable locals (selected candidate, its index, and the first unavailable result). Move that into resolveCronPreflight alongside the candidate list it consumes in run-fallback-policy, returning a closed ok/reason result so the caller reads a decision instead of reconstructing one. The lazy model-preflight loader moves to its only consumer. The pre-run persistence failure policy stays in run-prepare: the function it guards is also awaited from run-finalize and run-executor. * refactor(gateway): give talk.client.create its own module talk-client.ts sat just under the 700-line cap with a ~360-line create handler inline. Move it to talk-client-create.ts, matching the existing sibling handler modules (talk-client-run-ownership, talk-session-mark), so the handlers object reads as a routing table again. Extraction exposed a redundant type assertion; removing it shrinks the assertion-safety baseline by one entry.
